description: This header file declares functions and structures related to executing Git commands and managing executable paths. It defines interfaces for setting the execution path, resolving executable directories, preparing command arguments, and executing commands via execv and execl. It also includes a declaration for a 'strvec' structure used in command preparation.

classes.name: strvec
classes.description: A forward declaration of a structure likely used to handle vector of strings.

methods.name: git_set_exec_path
methods.description: Sets the executable search path for Git commands.

methods.name: git_resolve_executable_dir
methods.description: Resolves the directory of the given executable path.

methods.name: git_exec_path
methods.description: Returns the configured Git executable path.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Initializes or configures the system's PATH environment or internal path state.

methods.name: prepare_git_cmd
methods.description: Prepares the command argument vector for executing a Git command, outputs via a strvec object.

methods.name: execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with a given argument vector, replacing the current process.

methods.name: execl_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with variable arguments, replacing the current process.

methods.name: system_path
methods.description: Retrieves or manipulates system PATH environment variable for executing commands.
